name: Mixed internal and external HITL review packet

patterns_used: Separate source populations by originating module and retain system-like field order.
Vary row density by population instead of normalizing every sheet.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only abstract source-population separation and density variation; rebuild all package bytes, facts, identifiers, values, and styles from the authorized new world.

patterns_used: Use restrained one-page structure for a board decision or approved handoff endpoint.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only the restrained decision-endpoint pattern where the package lifecycle calls for it; create every decision record and fact from the authorized new world.

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only lifecycle, approval, attachment, distribution, and retention concepts; do not reproduce reviewed form content, layout, identities, or evidence.

producer: Finance, operations, legal, HR, external counterparties, and source systems
purpose: Provide a realistic evidence package that a knowledgeable human reviewer must synthesize across independent sources.
medium: ZIP package containing native Office files, PDFs, EML, and system exports

authority.governing_scope: Distributes governing facts across explicitly identified authoritative records and their supported decompositions.
authority.non_governing_scope: Context, questions, superseded work, and incidental records cannot silently override authoritative evidence.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world evidence manifest and authority map
Independently produced internal, external, and source-system records
excluded_inputs: Private controls, answer keys, and build files
Facts or identities copied from prior submissions
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The package authority map identifies the controlling source by scope; unresolved contradictions remain explicit review issues.

natural_depth: Contextual policies and incidental administrative content
No private controls, answer keys, or build files
footprint.source_owned_rationale: File count and variation arise from independent producers, source systems, evidence roles, attachments, and lifecycle stages needed for the review workflow.

sequence: Records reviewed or executed according to their own lifecycles
Approved evidence assembled using the authority map

features: Clean executed records beside selectively handled working copies

prohibited: Combined notes that reveal the answer

proof_gates.procedure: Open every file and reconcile the complete evidence chain and package manifest.
Render every paginated page, workbook sheet, message body, and material attachment.
Inspect properties, hidden content, links, comments, revisions, MIME fields, and container metadata.
Recompute all material formulas and reconcile cross-file amounts and identifiers.
Trace every package member and governing fact to the approved world manifest.
Run package-wide visible, hidden, metadata, filename, and extracted-text leakage review.
Verify the authority map resolves governing, supporting, contextual, and superseded records.
Map every file and material section to its producer, purpose, source, and lifecycle.
